asr.full_text: Hello everyone and welcome back to the Crypto Addiction. Before we dive into the video don't forget to subscribe for all the latest news about cryptocurrency. One project that has seen its token price rally to a new all-time high following the launch of a highly anticipated upgrade is Terra LUNA. A blockchain protocol that uses fiat-pegged stablecoins like Terra UST, UST, to create a global payment system. on the world. This will give us a better understanding of the trading behavior of Bitcoin or Bitcoin as it was in the first few months of its early days. Bitcoin has been a strong market to grow. And so, Bitcoin is now the market for a large number of other digital coins such as Ethereum. However, Bitcoin is the best option for crypto-chip. Bitcoin is already big into crypto-chip, and has been able to sell its assets in the last Bitcoin dominance is currently high. However, this video focuses on Terra – a token which I believe has a huge potential to reach $300 on this bull run! What is Terra? Terra is a Blockchain Protocol that allows users to create stableCoins which are pegged to fiat currencies. It was developed in 2018 and its main net officially launched in April 2019, Terra amalgamates the price stability and broad adoption of fiat currencies with bitcoin censorship resistance and provides fast and cheap settlements. The Terra Protocol operates on a proof-of-stake blockchain. Terra utilizes fiat-pegged stablecoins to power price-stable international payments systems. These coins mainly utilize the network's Seniorage system, which uses the Tender Mint Delegated Proof of Stake as its consensus mechanism. Terra offers smart contract efficiency for the establishment of various stable coin types. Terra Stable Coins Terra offers a broad variety of stable coins which include the Terra USD , Tera MNT , Tera KRW and Tera SDR . These stable coins are pegged to fiat currencies. Terra provides stable coins pegged to the Mongolian Tugrik South Korean Won and the international monetary funds Special Drawing Rights basket of currencies which include the US Dollar , the Chinese Renminbi, the Japanese Yen and the British pound Sterling. Terra is becoming increasingly popular in the Asian markets for e-commerce and has a wide user base in South Korea. For instance, the stablecoin Terra pegged to the Mongolian Thug Rig is used by taxi users in Mongolia to pay some drivers. Tokens minted on the Terra platform are known as Terra currencies and exist beside Luna. Luna holders can submit and vote on governance proposals allowing it to function as a Governance token. A governance token means that holders have voting rights on what takes place with the project. LUNA has an active maximum supply of 1 billion Tokens meaning the network is meant to burn LUNA coins if its supply exceeds 1 billion. Reasons why Terra price might hit a new all-time-high of $300 in this bull run. The successful launch of the long awaited Columbus 5 upgrade Lunar price might hit a new all-time high of $300. The successful launch of the long-awaited Columbus 5 upgrade is just one of the factors in Lunar's Ascension to a new record high, and it is not stopping anytime soon. Protocol upgrades are one of the biggest drivers of momentum because they show developers dedicated to fixing bugs, incorporating user requests, adding new features that make the protocol competitive and shore up the token's value. Three reasons for the price breakout in LUNA include the launch of its Columbus 5 upgrade which introduced a LUNA burning mechanism the protocol's adoption of the IBC standard which opens Terra to the Cosmos ecosystem and an increase in Defi applications and total value locked on the protocol. Now let's look at these factors one after the other to see how it might push the Terra Luna Coin to $300 in this bull run Columbus V Upgrade Columbus V launched on September 30th, and according to Tera developers and independent analysts the upgrade is the most significant development to happen to the protocol to date one of the notable changes to come along with the upgrade was a modification to the project's tokenomic model which leads to all Luna used to mint ust being burned instead of going into the community pool according to data from terra there was 83232 million worth of Luna burned in the GeneSys Block of Columbus 5. This change has introduced deflationary pressure to the Lunas supply and it could help boost its price in the long term as demand for UST grows. According to Quan, the founder of Terra Luna, more than 60 projects are preparing to launch in the next six to eight weeks, and more than 60 projects are preparing to launch in the next 6 to 8 weeks, and More than 100 have recently announced plans for the end of the year or early 2022 with the launch of Columbus 5. More projects on Terra diversify and amplify the demand for our stablecoin UST, accelerating the expansion of the stablecoin supply and accruing value to Luna holders. Interblockchain Communication Standard A second reason for the boost in Luna's momentum was its integration with the interblockchain communication IBC standard, which allows the Terra network to communicate and interact with protocols in the Cosmos ecosystem. This integration opens up Terra and its's US t stablecoin to more widespread adoption throughout the cosmos ecosystem and make it the stable coin of choice for applications and chains in the network with a larger pool of projects now having access to US T this could lead to a further deflation in the supply of Luna because more will need to be burned in the process of minting new US t the total value burned in the process of minting new U.S.T. The total value locked in the Terra ecosystem is surging. A thirr reason for bolish Price movements in Luna has been the Network growing ecosystem of decentralized finance protocols that have helped to push the total value locked on the protocol to a new all-time high. According to data from DeFi Llama, the total value of assets locked on the Terra network reached up to a record of $10.07 billion on October 4th. Right as Luna price was now breaking out to a new record high. Currently Terra's TVL is above $10 billion and the top ranked platform in terms of TVL is Anchor Protocol with $3.86 billion. ANC is the main avenue for minting UST by pledging Luna, , as collateral. Other notable DeFi protocols on the network include Lido , which has a TVL of $3 billion. MIR with a TVL of $1.38 billion and TerraSwap, which has a $1.32 billion TVL. Another exciting news, four largest ecosystems now connected as Terra joins Wormhole. Leading Solana bridge protocol, Wormhole v2 has integrated a new connection with the Terra Luna ecosystem, creating a four-way bridge for digital assets between the four largest blockchain ecosystems. The integration includes UST, Terra's USD stablecoin. The ETH, SOL, BSC, Luna move is exciting NFT fans in particular, with the single interface acting as a one-stop-digitalstop digital asset port for all four networks. Technologically speaking, this is quite a development in Wormhole's capabilities as it tackles the burden of blockchain interoperability since launching in September. On the old Wormhole protocol V1, Luna users were able to pass Terra and UST assets through the bridge, but they became double wrapped assets, limiting their usage to platforms such as Sabre or Mercurial. But now the wormhole team have been able to do away with double wrapping entirely, unlocking the free flow of assets between the 4 ecosystems. Columbus 5 has driven Luna to a $38 billion valuation and the ecosystem's total locked valu now sits just shy of $10 Billion. Courtesy of a growing range of DEX and DeFi protocols, all of these and many factors are the likely reasons why we think that Terra-LUNA will break. The Terra ecosystem's fundamentals have been getting stronger of late. Inter-blockchain communication just went live on Terra's main net. Now, once the Relayer channels are set up users would be able to start transfering tokens between the Terra and Cosmos ecosystem. A host of bridges in space have already been trying to meld one's isolated blockchains into an interconnected ecosystem. Terra climbing into the bandwagon at this stage would be able to gravitate new users to its space. Thus, this move is set to benefit Terra's native ecosystem in the long run. Going forward, if things go as planned, Terra will essentially manage to establish a niche for itself. What's more, even the alt metrics are in fairly good shape. Luna's circulating supply, for starters, increased immensely in October, implying that more tokens are now circulating among market participants. To a fair extent, this means that they've been buying additional tokens, a fairly good sign for its price. Luna's market cap dominance has also been revolving around 3%, pretty good for a top 20 alt. Its inflation rate has been under 5% for nearly more than 2 weeks now, implying that LUNA's long-term retention value is only getting stronger with time. I am extremely bullish on TERA & I think it won't stop on this bull run until it reaches the $300 mark. That's it on today's video. Thanks for watching and have a nice day!
